title: Echoes email record
description: A single derived email record. All values must come from a source file in docs/; do not invent fields.

sender.description: Sender as stated in the source.

recipients.description: Recipients as stated in the source.

subject.description: Subject line as stated in the source.

case_id.description: Case ID as stated in the source, or null if the source does not provide one.

source_file.description: Path to the primary source file, relative to the repository root (under docs/).

summary.description: Short factual summary of the source; do not invent events.
